field_conflicts.description: All pair-collision indicators sharing texts are not jointly independent; non-implication of subspace events does not prove joint independence. The conditional last-query argument needs the rarity of a prefix admitting completion: any nonempty favorable response set for a fixed compatible query has probability at least1/(2^128-N+1), so the claimed2^-65618 cannot follow from final-response uniformity alone. This is a proof gap in the numerical ideal-reference claim, not a changed AES construction or repaired full-game bound.
